in_arabic.name: فروى
in_arabic.meaning: الاسم يعني الحماية والسلام والرفاهية للشخص
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فروى مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ف-ر-ى' والذي يعني الحماية والرفاهية. في اللغة العربية، يعني الاسم الحماية من الله والسلام الداخلي. كما ورد في بعض التفاسير القرآنية، يرتبط الاسم بالشعور بالأمان والطمأنينة. استخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية كدلالة على الحماية الإلهية.

in_urdu.name: فروا
in_urdu.meaning: نام کا مطلب ہے حفاظت، سلامتی اور خوشحالی
in_urdu.long_meaning: فروا نام عربی جڑ 'ف-ر-ى' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے حفاظت اور خوشحالی۔ اردو میں، یہ نام اللہ کی حفاظت اور اندرونی سلامتی کے معنی میں استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان الثقافتی اور مذہبی اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر اسلامی روایات میں حفاظت اور رزق کی برکت کے طور پر۔

in_hindi.name: फरवा
in_hindi.meaning: नाम का अर्थ है सुरक्षा, शांति और समृद्धि
in_hindi.long_meaning: फरवा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'फ-र-ى' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है सुरक्षा और समृद्धि। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अल्लाह की सुरक्षा और आंतरिक शांति के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम सुरक्षा और आशीर्वाद के अर्थ में प्रयोग होता है, और यह नाम अक्सर बच्चों के लिए शुभ माना जाता है।

in_english.name: Farwa
in_english.meaning: The name means protection, safety, and well-being
in_english.long_meaning: The name Farwa originates from the Arabic root 'ف-ر-ى' (F-R-Y), which signifies protection, safety, and well-being. In Islamic tradition, the name is associated with divine protection and inner peace. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote a sense of security and blessing. The name Farwa is also linked to Quranic concepts of safety and divine care, reflecting a profound spiritual significance. In contemporary times, the name continues to be popular among Muslim families worldwide, symbolizing a desire for their children to be under divine protection.

In Islamic culture, water holds a great significance as it is one of the basic necessities for life, according to the teachings of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The concept of the freshness and coldness of water in the name represents not only its physical attributes, but also the tranquility and calmness it evokes. Those named Farwa are often perceived as soothing, cool, and serene.
data.spiritual_significance: Farwa is deeply rooted in Islamic spirituality due to its association with purity and renewal. In the Islamic tradition, ablution or wudu is a cleansing ritual that is performed several times daily as a means of spiritual purification. Water plays a central role in this ritual, reminding us of the importance of cleansing ourselves both physically and spiritually. The name Farwa serves as a constant reminder of the power and necessity of water in both physical and spiritual realms. It also signifies the idea of rebirth and renewal, echoing the Prophet's Hadith: "If the last hour does not come and you live to see it, then continue to perform your five daily Prayers and fast during the month of Ramadan." (Bukhari and Muslim) Thus, those named Farwa are symbolically connected to the divine power of purification, transformation, and renewal.
